channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages, Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts and Azure updates. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: AZ577618: Generally Available: ABFS Vectored Read for Azure Data Lake Storage
item.description: ABFS Vectored Read helps compatible analytics engines reduce request overhead for selective reads in Azure Data Lake Storage. By combining nearby file ranges into fewer storage requests and executing reads asynchronously, it can reduce network round trips for workloads such as selective Parquet queries. Compatible Spark workloads can enable the capability through configuration, without rewriting queries or migrating data. Learn more .

item.title: MC1520901: Insights Agent V2 Frontier
item.description: Insights Agent V2 is now available in Frontier, providing M365 admins tenant-level visibility into agent adoption and control over user feedback sharing. Feedback sharing is off by default and can be enabled in the Microsoft 365 admin center. No compliance issues identified. Public preview rollout is complete.

item.title: MC1519861: Outlook: Copilot Prioritize feature will be retired
item.description: The Copilot Prioritize feature in Outlook will be retired starting October 26, 2026, with removal completed by March 2027. It will be removed from all Outlook clients without requiring opt-in. No admin action is needed, but users should be notified and support materials updated accordingly.

item.title: MC1450126: Migrate your offline or signed-out devices to the Pro Management Portal for administration
item.description: Microsoft is transitioning Teams Android device management from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal by October 2026. Devices must run a supported Admin Agent version, updated automatically if online. Offline or outdated devices require manual updates to maintain management functionality. Administrators should verify updates and complete the transition steps promptly.

item.title: MC1480870: New SharePoint Mobile Experience on iOS and Android
item.description: The SharePoint mobile app for iOS and Android will roll out a redesigned home with a personalized Discover experience by late October to November 2026. It features improved site browsing, file previews, refreshed news, search, dark mode, and better performance, with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1309743: Viva Engage: Email updates for users without a routable mailbox
item.description: Starting mid-October 2026, Viva Engage will stop sending email notifications to users without valid mailboxes or routable email destinations, reducing email system load and improving delivery. Users with supported mailboxes and Teams notifications remain unaffected. No action is required, but review mailbox configurations and update support accordingly.

item.title: MC1450127: End-of-support Android devices may not be manageable through the Pro Management Portal
item.description: Microsoft is transitioning Teams Android device management from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal by October 2026. Supported devices will auto-update to a required Admin Agent version, while end-of-support devices may lose manageability. Administrators should verify device updates and readiness for PMP.

item.title: MC1509787: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support certified third-party synthetic audio and video detection in meetings starting mid-November 2026. Organizations can integrate these solutions to enhance security against AI-generated media threats. Admins must deploy provider apps, grant permissions, and configure meeting policies. Detection is performed by third parties, with Microsoft Teams enabling integration.

item.description: In October 2026, we are updating read access for custom connector definitions in Power Platform. Users assigned the Dataverse Basic User security role will no longer be able to read solution custom connector definitions unless the connector is owned by that user or explicitly shared with them. item.title: MC1458484: Filter Messages by Events on Outlook Mobile
item.description: Outlook Mobile will add an "Events" filter to quickly find calendar invitations and event-related messages. Rolling out worldwide and in GCC environments from late August to late September 2026. No admin action needed; users can better manage meeting invites and RSVPs.

item.title: MC1519871: Copilot Code is rolling out in Frontier
item.description: Copilot Code, an AI-powered coding tool in Microsoft Copilot, is rolling out in the Frontier program starting late October 2026. It enables users with licenses and spending policies to build, refine, and publish apps using natural language, with admin-controlled usage-based billing and optional local coding on PC.

item.title: MC1519866: Microsoft Teams: Phishing detection for messaging
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce AI-powered, context-aware phishing detection starting November 2026, focusing on external first-contact chats and additional protection for mobile users in China. It identifies suspicious behavior without retaining message content, requires no admin action, and aims solely for security protection.

item.title: MC1519860: Intelligent Call Delegation in Teams
item.description: Intelligent Call Delegation in Teams uses AI to answer calls, gather context, and schedule follow-ups via Microsoft Bookings, helping users focus on important conversations. Rolling out from November 2026 (preview) to January 2027 (general availability), it requires appropriate licensing and admin configuration. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1519857: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android with Teams Rooms Pro license will gain access to a private presenter chat in green room-enabled meetings/events when joined as organizers. This backstage chat appears as "Event group" or "Planning group." Rollout starts August 2025 (preview) and completes November 2026 (general availability). No admin action needed.

item.title: MC1519856: Projects in Copilot
item.description: Projects in Copilot unify related chats, Cowork tasks, files, and context in one place, reducing repeated explanations. Available now in Cowork-tab (Windows, Mac, Web), with rollout to Chat and Cowork on Frontier soon. Files remain in OneDrive with existing permissions; no action or compliance concerns required.

item.title: MC1519855: Microsoft Entra: Choose your own telephony provider for SMS and voice authentication
item.description: Starting October 30, 2026, Microsoft Entra ID allows organizations to choose a supported third-party telephony provider for SMS and voice authentication via Microsoft Security Store. Microsoft-provided SMS/voice authentication retires by February 1, 2027, except for some users until July 1, 2027. Organizations manage provider relationships directly.

item.title: MC1519846: Microsoft 365 apps: Updated Brand Kit management experience
item.description: Microsoft 365 apps updated the Brand Kit management experience to simplify setup, streamline asset management, and improve workflows for Brand Managers. The update is available worldwide with no action required, helping organizations efficiently maintain on-brand content and scale creation using Copilot.

item.title: MC1519843: New Outlook for Windows: All Accounts view brings email into a single inbox view
item.description: The new Outlook for Windows introduces an All Accounts view, a unified inbox showing emails from multiple accounts separately without merging. It supports AI-assisted workflows and search, rolling out globally by late October 2026. No admin action is needed now; controls will be available later.

item.title: MC1519842: Microsoft OneNote: JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Microsoft OneNote now supports using JPG and PNG images as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks, enabling Copilot to extract and use visual content for generating outputs. The feature is globally available since October 2026, requires no admin action, and affects users with Copilot Notebook access.

item.title: MC1519841: Microsoft OneNote: CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Microsoft OneNote now supports using CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks, enhancing content generation with structured data. The feature is globally available since mid-October 2026, requires no user action, and automatically enables for tenants with existing CSV/TSV Copilot permissions.

item.title: RM560318: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM566528: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Extend Purview data security to the network layer via Entra GSA integration
item.description: Extend Microsoft Purview data security controls to the network layer to detect and protect sensitive data in text and prompts by integrating with Entra Internet Access. This integration enables organizations to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enforce restrictive actions based on DLP policies, and detect risky user activity through Insider Risk Management. item.title: RM567315: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
item.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done i...

item.title: RM576711: Microsoft Teams: AI Interpreter for Teams Events
item.description: AI Interpreter for Events brings real-time, AI-powered audio interpretation to Teams Town Halls and Webinars, helping global audiences follow events in their preferred language. Organizers can configure supported languages for their event, giving attendees a more natural and engaging multilingual experience beyond translated captions.

item.title: RM567302: Microsoft Teams: Ability for IT admins to customize the user notification messages for recording and transcription in calls
item.description: This feature enables IT admins to customize a portion of the user notification messages for recording and transcription during Teams calls.

item.title: RM568372: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - SLA Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
item.description: Out-of-box MTTA/MTTD/MTTR SLA Alert Reporting dashboard showing past trends, Top SITs getting exposed via DLP alerts generated. Customers can define their custom SLAs for high, med and low severity alerts and get access to dashboard showing operational performance and SLA metrics.

item.title: RM576199: Microsoft Teams: Expanded Markdown support in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding Markdown support in the compose box, giving you more ways to structure and format messages using familiar Markdown syntax. Create richer, more readable messages while staying in the Markdown authoring experience.

item.title: RM570864: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Keep Project Staffing and Field Service Scheduling Aligned
item.description: Deliver consistent scheduling outcomes across Dynamics 365 Project Operations and Field Service, regardless of where scheduling begins. When a project task includes resource assignments and planned effort, that demand is represented on the related work order with the same role, resource, duration, and scheduling window. item.title: RM573708: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Support Approver Comments for Expense Reports in Expense Management Mobile app
item.description: Approvers using the Expense Management Mobile App currently have limited options to provide context when approving or rejecting expense reports. Approval decisions may require comments to provide justification, request clarification, document additional information, or communicate feedback to employees. Without this capability in the mobile experience, approvers may need to switch to the web application to complete the approval process.

item.title: RM573260: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add an interim approver when you submit an expense report
item.description: This feature introduces support for a simple interim approval scenario for expense reports. When someone submits an expense report, organizations can designate an interim approver to review and approve expenses before the final approver can review and approve. Interim approver must review expense reports to confirm whether they're complete and compliant before final approver.

item.title: RM573261: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use Expense Manager role center
item.description: The Expense Manager Role Center is updated to provide a more focused and efficient experience for managing vendor and expense-related activities. The enhancements align the workspace with typical expense management workflows, ensuring that key information and actions are readily accessible. Where relevant, other Role Centers are also updated to include access to expense management features.

item.title: RM573263: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Use approvals with fixed asset journals
item.description: Organizations can use approval workflows with Fixed Asset Journals, which gives them the same level of control and oversight for fixed assets that's available for other journals in Business Central.

item.title: RM573264: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Use batch totals for payment journals
item.description: The Batch Total field on the Payment Journal page enhances payment processing by enabling you to work with and review a cumulative total for a payment journal batch. By surfacing batch-level totals directly in payment journals, organizations gain better control over outgoing payments and can streamline review and approval processes.

item.title: RM573291: Microsoft Edge: Simplified Energy Saver
item.description: Energy saver, formerly known as efficiency mode, will have new defaults and different setting options. Edge will now support and recommend users to use the BatterySaverModeAvailability policy to manage the energy saver feature. The energy saver feature has been simplified to become enabled under two conditions: on low battery or when unplugged. The default will be for energy saver to be enabled on low battery. item.title: RM573700: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Sales Development Agent is now available
item.description: Autonomous agent that researches, qualifies, engages with leads, scaling sales capacity 24/7.

item.title: RM576296: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Restrict task assignments to project team members
item.description: This feature strengthens assignment governance by limiting the resources displayed in the Assigned to column to members of the current project team. Project managers can assign tasks only to resources who have already been added to the project, instead of selecting from the organization’s complete resource list.

item.title: RM575296: Power Apps: Form fill assistance supports more field types
item.description: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to support lookup, rich text, and multi-select choice fields, helping users complete more of their forms with AI-powered suggestions and less manual entry.

item.title: RM576282: Power Apps: Monitor generative pages with out-of-the-box Application Insights telemetry
item.description: Admins and developers can monitor published generative pages with Application Insights. When an administrator configures Application Insights data export for an environment, Power Apps automatically exports completed page loads, unhandled errors, supported Data API operations, and navigation initiated from generative pages without requiring telemetry code, the Application Insights JavaScript SDK, or a connection string on the page.

item.title: RM576284: Power Apps: Use Dataverse custom APIs in generative pages
item.description: Makers can have a generative page call a Dataverse custom API to run server-side business logic, such as approving an order, recalculating a price, or validating a transaction. From either the Maker Studio generative page designer or the generative pages AI plugin, makers select a prepared API and describe when the page should call it, which input values to provide, and how to use the response.

item.title: RM573257: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expense reports per trip automatically
item.description: Expense Agent can automatically create expense reports based on identified business trips. You just need to configure the feature on the Expense Agent Setup page. Instead of manually collecting and organizing individual expense entries, you can use the agent to group relevant expenses and generate a dedicated expense report for each trip. item.title: RM575295: Power Apps: Form fill assistance in apps can provide suggestions for existing values
item.description: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to suggest updates to fields that already contain values—not just empty fields. This helps users update existing information with ease using AI-powered skills in their apps.

item.title: RM577175: Microsoft Viva: Glint - Teams notification customization
item.description: Viva Glint admins can now customize the Microsoft Teams notifications sent for surveys. Admins can edit the title, message, and button label in each survey language and see their changes in a live preview. Teams and email messages stay consistent and match your organization's voice, which helps more employees see the survey and take part.

item.title: AZ577273: Announcing: Choose Your Own Telephony (CYOT) for Microsoft Entra
item.description: What and why Starting October 30, 2026, Microsoft Entra ID will make the Choose Your Own Telephony Provider experience available. This feature enables organizations to use a supported third-party telecommunications provider for SMS and voice authentication. Organizations select a supported provider through Microsoft Security Store and manage their commercial relationship directly with the provider. item.title: AZ576716: Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation
item.description: Safe Key Rotation for Azure Cosmos DB is now generally available. You can view timestamp metadata showing when each account key was last used, helping you identify active keys before rotating or retiring credentials. This visibility helps reduce the risk of service disruptions caused by disabling keys that are still in use. It also gives you actionable insights to improve credential management, maintain application continuity, and support modern security and compliance practices. Learn more .

item.title: MC1469564: Microsoft Publisher: Reminder that support ends in October 2026
item.description: Microsoft Publisher support ends October 1, 2026, and it will be removed from Microsoft 365 Apps via updates starting November 2026. Users should convert or migrate .pub files to Word, PowerPoint, or Microsoft Create before then, as Publisher will no longer open or edit files after this date.

item.title: MC1480869: Microsoft 365 settings enabled by default for newly created Engage communities
item.description: Newly created Microsoft Viva Engage communities will have Microsoft 365 group settings enabled by default, subscribing members to community emails and calendar invites. Rollout completes by November 2026. Community owners can adjust settings via the My Account portal. No admin action is required. Existing communities update later this fall.

item.title: MC1519122: Microsoft Copilot: UBB models in Chat and Word, Excel, and PowerPoint via the model selector
item.description: Usage-based billing (UBB) models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, will be available in Microsoft Copilot Chat and Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint starting November 2026. Access requires enabling UBB, assigning credits, and a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Admins manage billing and credit allocation.

item.title: MC1518233: Copilot Studio - Enhanced support for Copilot Chat agents
item.description: We are announcing the enhancement to improve support for building Copilot Chat agents, also known as declarative agents, that provide authoritative answers and standardized content in Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability on October 26, 2026. How does this affect me? Copilot Studio users will see the following capabilities when building Copilot Chat agents: Topics for deterministic conversational flows Connected agents to delegate work Evaluations to improve agent quality...

item.title: MC1518085: Microsoft Copilot Studio - Improvements to agent Evaluations experience
item.description: We are enhancing the Evaluations experience to help makers better understand agent quality and behavior in Microsoft Copilot Studio. This feature is now available. How does this affect me? The improvements will bring new capabilities that help makers identify quality issues more quickly, understand why evaluations succeed or fail, compare results across runs, and create higher quality evaluation datasets with less manual effort. item.title: MC1518036: Microsoft Copilot - Admin controls to manage Business Applications in Work IQ
item.description: We are announcing the public preview of admin controls for managing Business Applications in Work IQ. This feature enables business applications data to help ground AI experiences alongside Microsoft 365 productivity data, while providing layered controls over which experiences, environments, apps, and data can participate. This feature will reach public preview by November 17, 2026. How does this affect me? Your organization will be able to make business applications data available to Work IQ e...

item.title: MC1518034: Clipchamp/ Copilot 'Create a video' experience is going to have an admin control available
item.description: Microsoft Clipchamp will add an admin policy control to manage user access to the AI-powered "Create a video" feature, rolling out worldwide from late November to early December 2026. Admins can enable or restrict this feature via Microsoft 365 admin center policies. No user action is needed if access is allowed.

item.title: MC1518033: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce an onboarding workflow to automatically connect new members to relevant channels, improving engagement and onboarding speed. Rollout starts November 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by mid-December 2026 (General Availability). No admin action is needed; inform team owners accordingly.

item.title: RM577186: Microsoft Edge: Organize and merge PDF files in the built-in PDF reader
item.description: Users can organize and merge PDF files in the Microsoft Edge built-in PDF reader. They can select pages to extract, delete, rotate, or reorder, and save the result as a new PDF file. They can also merge the open PDF file with other PDF files that are open in Microsoft Edge tabs or stored on their device, to create a single PDF file. Files are processed on the device, and the original files aren't modified. Admins can manage this feature using the PdfOrganizeAndMergeEnabled policy.

item.title: RM577185: Microsoft Dataverse: Enable semantic data understanding for agentic use
item.description: Give AI agents and Copilot a true understanding of your business data — not just raw schema — so they can answer questions accurately with less manual configuration.

item.title: RM577182: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Simplify the creation of recurring expenses
item.description: This feature enables employees to automatically generate expense entries for predictable, repeatable business expenses (for example, monthly mobile bills, internet charges, parking, and subscriptions) without manual re-entry each period. It reduces repetitive effort, improves compliance, and ensures timely and accurate expense submission, while respecting organizational expense policies and approval workflows.

item.title: RM577183: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Multi-grader comparison
item.description: Multi-grader comparison enables makers to compare the results of multiple graders applied to the same evaluation.
item.category: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

item.title: RM577187: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-View-only access to device onboarding with the View-Only Device Management role
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is introducing more granular, role-based access to the Devices page under Settings → Device Onboarding. Previously, viewing or managing device onboarding required broad administrative roles (such as Compliance Administrator, Global Administrator, or Security Administrator). With this update, organizations can grant access using least-privilege Purview role-based access control (RBAC) roles scoped specifically to device operations.

item.title: RM575293: Outlook: Teams Meeting Options
item.description: When you add a Teams meeting to an event in Outlook for Mac, the join link and dial-in details now appear in the invite while you're still writing it. A new Meeting Options button lets you change the Teams meeting settings right away, before you send.

item.title: RM577184: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Manage intraday operations with AI agent

item.title: RM571884: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
item.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

item.title: RM500019: Microsoft 365: Backup Activity Logs
item.description: In product monitoring logs to track all activities related to backup policy configuration & restore related tasks. This will help admins with troubleshooting, monitoring, reporting and auditing capabilities.

item.title: RM503570: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support permission sync missed in incremental crawl
item.description: Earlier, permissions were synced only in the periodic full crawl which generally ha a default frequency of 1 day for most of the connectors. Now, we have support for doing permission syncs more frequently in an incremental way.

item.title: RM555894: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
item.description: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

item.title: RM558251: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Enhanced Rollout Waves
item.description: New improvements are coming to the rollout wave functionality for Cloud Update. These enhancements will allow organizations to continue leveraging Microsoft Entra ID groups to set up rollout waves, with increased flexibility to configure more than the current limit of three waves. Additionally, admins will be able to assign custom delays between each wave, streamlining phased deployments and offering greater control over update distribution.

item.title: RM560538: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
item.description: Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed.

item.title: RM560820: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
item.description: Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archive beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

item.title: RM568936: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator Can Join Channel Meetings
item.description: Facilitator can now join meetings set up in Teams channels. Facilitator helps participants run more effective meetings through the ability to take live notes, manage the agenda, answer questions, and capture tasks.

item.title: RM574126: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric
item.description: Connect Business Central to Microsoft Fabric to make business data available for analytics, reporting, and data integration.

item.title: RM568790: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot makes PDF reviews faster and easier on mobile. Select text in any PDF in OneDrive iOS and tap Ask Copilot to explain, summarize, translate, or ask a custom question about the selection — the same in-context Copilot experience already generally available on desktop, now on OneDrive iOS. Updated October 20, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM576609: Microsoft Teams: Default meeting templates
item.description: Default meeting templates enable IT admins to automatically apply their organization’s preferred meeting settings whenever users schedule a Teams meeting through Outlook or Teams calendar. This helps organizations apply meeting settings (including protection settings) at scale, and reduce the need for organizers to manually configure meeting options. Only organizers with a Teams Premium (T-Pre) license assigned can use Default Meeting Templates.

item.title: RM570157: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns Hub in Engage and Engage in Teams mobile
item.description: The Campaigns Hub in Viva Engage provides a centralized mobile destination where employees can discover and participate in organizational campaigns. Available in the Viva Engage app and Viva Engage in Teams mobile, the hub highlights top and sponsored campaigns, enables users to browse active and completed campaigns, and makes it easy to view campaign details and follow the campaigns that matter to them.

item.title: RM570448: OneDrive: Sync support for up to 1 million items on macOS
item.description: OneDrive Sync supports syncing up to 1 million items on macOS devices, helping teams manage large document libraries and shared content at scale without compromising access across devices. This preview requires the Insiders ring and that devices meet minimum hardware and configuration requirements. Devices that don't meet these requirements continue to sync at the existing 300,000-item supported limit with no disruption.

item.title: RM570646: Microsoft Teams: Organize important resources in chats and channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new way to organize and access important resources in chats and channels. Users will be able to pin key content, including links, files, and messages, directly beneath the chat or channel header for quick access. Resources can also be organized into folders, making it easier to keep important information visible and discoverable in active conversations. This update provides a more consistent experience across chats and channels, helping users stay organized, quic...

item.title: RM571387: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
item.description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

item.title: RM572673: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Extended rollback support for Monthly Enterprise Channel
item.description: Cloud Update is expanding rollback options for devices on Monthly Enterprise Channel. Administrators will be able to roll back devices to a release from two versions prior, with the latest available security updates for that release, and keep devices in the rolled-back state across subsequent releases until they are ready to resume updates. This provides additional time to investigate and resolve compatibility issues while maintaining security coverage and centralized control through the Microso...

item.title: MC1518032: Microsoft 365 apps: Introducing Update Repair in Inventory
item.description: Update Repair in Inventory helps admins identify and fix Windows devices with outdated or problematic Microsoft 365 apps via the admin center. It enables remote Online Repair for eligible devices, rolling out from October to November 2026. Admins must enable Inventory and notify users before repairs.

item.title: MC1518030: Updated Photos experience on Windows 11
item.description: Windows 11 will receive an updated Photos app starting mid-October 2026, enhancing browsing, organizing, and viewing local and OneDrive photos. Existing app management and OneDrive policies remain effective. Organizations should review app-blocking rules and inform help desks; no new compliance issues are expected.

item.title: MC1266912: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Dashboard will automatically provide AI-generated intelligent summaries starting November 2026, highlighting adoption trends and usage insights for admins. No configuration is needed, existing permissions remain, and there is no user impact. Organizations can notify teams or update documentation if desired.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to store multiple lines of text as prompt column output to enable makers to save longer and more detailed AI-generated insights in Dataverse tables. Available by default to eligible users from early July 2026 (preview) and late August 2026 (general availability). No admin action required; future support for PDFs and Pages planned.

item.title: MC1511072: Microsoft Teams: Upcoming change to voicemail message delivery by email
item.description: Microsoft Teams will change voicemail email delivery by early March 2027, moving caller info from the email From field to the Subject line and allowing organizations to use their own domains for sending. Organizations should update mail-flow rules accordingly; no new compliance requirements arise.

item.title: MC1511071: Action required: Review property changes for Exchange Online scenarios
item.description: Exchange Online is deprecating certain properties in Get-Mailbox -Migration and New-Mailbox -Migration cmdlets starting November 15, 2026. Organizations must review and update scripts or workflows using these properties before then to avoid disruptions. Full details and guidance are provided in the linked Microsoft documentation.

item.title: MC1511056: Microsoft Copilot Studio – Teams app retirement
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Copilot Studio app in Teams by February 2027, transitioning all chatbot agent creation and management to the Copilot Studio web app. Editing in Teams ends January 2027. Users and admins should switch to the web app and update related documentation accordingly.

item.title: MC1511052: Upcoming changes to Agents in SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: SharePoint and OneDrive agents using the .agent file format will be upgraded to integrate with Microsoft Copilot’s extensibility ecosystem. From mid-November 2026, new agents use the Copilot Agent Builder, with .agent files supported until March 2027, after which they stop working. Organizations should prepare to upgrade agents and adopt new management and governance tools.

item.title: RM576886: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Boost technician productivity - Disable clickthrough on lookup values in forms
item.description: A new option in the lookup control lets you disable clickthrough on the displayed lookup value. When disabled, the lookup value renders as plain text (not a hyperlink), preventing users from unintentionally opening the related record. This applies to forms across web and mobile.

item.title: RM576884: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Optimize multiple resources with Scheduling Operations Agent
item.description: This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include multiple resources. The agent considers the availability of the resources, their current schedules, and unscheduled requirements. It suggests a schedule that honors configured constraints and optimizes it according to the selected goal. Dispatchers can review and compare the proposed schedules with the current schedules before applying changes.

item.title: RM576883: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - View budget details in left navigation
item.description: This feature enhances the Project Budget management experience by improving visibility, usability, and contextual clarity when working with project budgets and budget versions. It addresses limitations of the existing Project form Budget tab and reduces ambiguity around budget version actions.

item.title: RM576879: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Show accounting currency with the correct label
item.description: This feature lets different currency units show the actual record for the accounting currency when the unit differs from the base currency. Today the correct value is shown, but the units are incorrectly shown as the base currency, regardless of the actual accounting currency unit. In this feature, accounting currency fields are stored in a child record with the correct currency unit and appears with the correct label on the actual form.

item.title: RM576878: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Use what-if analysis on estimates
item.description: This feature introduces a robust what-if analysis capability for estimates that enables you to model scenarios and evaluate their impact on key financial goals.

item.title: RM576877: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Customize the task details pane
item.description: In the task grid, when you select the i icon next to a task name, the Task details pane opens so you can enter more information. This pane is part of Microsoft Project for the web and is embedded in an iframe that makes it non-customizable.

item.title: RM576871: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Sales and marketing - Calculate prices for external systems through API
item.description: The new pricing calculation API allows external systems to programmatically retrieve active prices or price quotes directly from Supply Chain Management. Based on key input data provided by the external system—such as product and customer details—Supply Chain Management provides real-time pricing and discount calculation results.

item.title: RM576870: Power Automate: Process mining - Analyze processes using object-centric process mining
item.description: Real business processes rarely flow as a single, linear instance. Events routinely touch several objects of different types at the same time (for example, creating an invoice for a specific order, or shipping a package that contains items from multiple orders). Object-centric process mining captures that reality by recording events that relate to many objects and object types in one process, preserving their relationships end‑to‑end.

item.title: RM576869: Power Automate: Process mining - Analyze your processes in the process intelligence experience
item.description: The process intelligence experience is a modern, flexible workspace designed for comprehensive process analysis. It provides a fully customizable analysis environment that combines multiple visualization and analysis components into cohesive, purpose-built workspaces. The platform empowers users to construct exactly the analytical view they need without technical complexity.

item.title: RM576868: Power Automate: Process mining - Create and visualize custom KPIs in the process intelligence experience
item.description: The process intelligence experience allows flexible metric creation with seamless visualization integration. This feature enables you to define custom KPIs and metrics tailored to specific business requirements within the process intelligence experience. You can create custom metrics using configurable formulas that can incorporate existing process data, standard KPIs, and mathematical operations.

item.title: RM576867: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Warehouse management - Enable precise serial and batch capture in cluster picking
item.description: This feature lets you control how serial and batch numbers are captured during cluster picking for items tracked below the location level in the reservation hierarchy. You get two new strategies in the cluster setup: capture serial and batch numbers once before distributing items or capture them separately for each cluster position. The new Enum in the cluster setup UI makes it easy to choose your preferred mode, so you can ensure every serial or batch number is matched to the right order.

item.title: RM576866: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Warehouse management - Streamline transfer order receiving in WOM with ASNs
item.description: Receive transfer orders in warehouse-only mode with a single license plate scan. This feature uses ASN-based packing structures to speed up inbound shipment processing and improve accuracy. The packing structure is defined within the ASN, so you can streamline your receiving workflow and reduce manual steps.

item.title: RM576865: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Warehouse management - Automate dynamic work classification with Power FX
item.description: Dynamic work classification powered by Power FX formulas lets you evaluate warehouse queries in real time, so you can prioritize work based on load priority or any operational data. This removes the need for multiple location directives or work templates, reducing configuration complexity and making your warehouse more responsive. You use familiar Power FX capabilities from Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and the Power Platform to define and adjust operational logic with a flexible, low-code appr...

item.title: RM576864: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Reporting and data analysis - Use new APIs for analyzing approval workflows for auditors and IT staff
item.description: In this release wave, we're introducing read-only APIs on the (workflow) approval system. This allows for establishing security and auditing analytics and reporting outside Business Central—for example, creating reports with Power BI or agents with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server for Business Central.

item.title: RM576863: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Security and compliance - Prevent sending sensitive data to Purview audit logs
item.description: To help prevent leaking sensitive customer data from Dataverse audit logs, all customer data is removed before these audit events are sent to Purview activity logging. Examples of sensitive customer data include financial information, medical and health data, and personally identifiable information.

item.title: RM576862: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Copy externally scheduled projects
item.description: Project Operations supports Externally scheduled projects, where organizations use their own scheduling engine and manage project schedules outside of Project Operations. Previously, the Copy Project capability was available only for Project for the Web scheduled projects. Customers using externally scheduled projects had to manually recreate project structures, configurations, and related data when starting similar projects or creating project templates.

item.title: RM576861: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Update key project fields using Copy project
item.description: Today, when you select Copy Project, the system creates a project and copies everything from the source project to the newly created project. In this flow, you aren't allowed to update fields like contracting unit, owning company, and other key fields for the new project.

item.title: RM576860: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Post project invoice proposals using multithreaded batch tasks
item.description: For organizations delivering complex projects, a single invoice proposal can include thousands of invoice lines. Similarly, thousands of customers might need to invoice every billing cycle. In both cases, the window is often short between the time users submit all transactions for the period, review them, and generate invoices. This feature significantly improves performance when posting the project invoice proposal and makes the final invoice document available.

item.title: RM576859: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Configure maximum daily time entry duration
item.description: Project Operations sets a 24-hour limit on daily time entry hours that can be logged (including vacation hours). Administrators can modify this out-of-the-box validation in the Parameters section to meet their organization’s needs. Administrators can set a preferred maximum duration (in minutes) and provide a more realistic limit (for example, 9 hours) for time entry users. This configuration is checked each time a new time entry is created or modified.

item.title: RM576858: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Configure minimum interval of time entry duration
item.description: Customers can now configure the allowable increment for time entry durations to ensure that all logged time adheres to their organization’s time-tracking policies. When enabled, you can only create or modify time entries whose duration is a multiple of the configured value (for example, 15 minutes, or 1 hour), helping prevent erroneous or non-compliant time entries from being recorded.

item.title: RM576857: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Enable time-zone-independent behavior in the time entry grid
item.description: Administrators can now enable time-zone-independent behavior for the Time Entry Grid so that time entries appear on the same calendar date, regardless of a user's time zone. This helps organizations with globally distributed teams maintain a consistent view of reported time and eliminates issues where entries appear on different dates due to time zone conversions.

item.title: RM576844: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Financial Management - Calculate taxes for plastic and sugar
item.description: Business Central introduces new capabilities in excise journals to calculate tax amounts for plastic and sugar based on legislation requirements that use weight, content, and transaction quantities as the basis for excise taxes. The new Excise Tax Type, Qty. for Excise Tax, and Excise UOM fields on the Item Card and Fixed Asset Card pages let you define material composition and the relevant quantity basis for each product or fixed asset.

item.title: RM576843: Microsoft Dataverse: Activate Enterprise Data in Copilot - Create Dataverse agent users with Microsoft Entra agent identity
item.description: Organizations can securely deploy AI agents to access and interact with Dataverse data by using enterprise‑managed Microsoft Entra agent identities. This feature enables agents to be provisioned as Dataverse agent users with dedicated, least‑privileged security roles based on their intended capabilities. This feature ensures agents have only the access required to perform tasks autonomously or on behalf of users.

item.title: RM576842: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Supervisor experiences - Provide real-time coaching with Quality Assurance Agent
item.description: The quality evaluation skill of the Quality Assurance Agent now includes real-time coaching, enabling organizations to shift from post-interaction monitoring to in-the-moment guidance during live conversations. Service representatives receive contextual coaching nudges during live conversations based on configured quality criteria and guardrails, allowing immediate course correction and improved interaction quality.

item.title: RM576841: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Reporting and data analysis - Use new APIs for analyzing permissions for auditors and IT staff
item.description: In this release wave, we're introducing read-only APIs on the permission system. This allows for establishing security and auditing analytics and reporting outside Business Central—for example, creating reports with Power BI or agents with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server for Business Central.

item.title: RM576840: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Boost technician productivity - Add simplified lookup control
item.description: A new Power Apps component framework control, Drawer Lookup, is now available for lookup fields on forms. This control provides a streamlined mobile UI, reducing visible clutter and minimizing taps compared to the standard lookup. It's available exclusively for mobile experiences.

item.title: RM576839: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Country and regional - Use Payment Practices in the UK localization
item.description: Business Central extends UK localization to support the updated Reporting on Payment Practices and Performance (Amendment) Regulations 2024. The system introduces new data points to the existing Payment Practices page, including the total value of payments made during the period, late payments relative to agreed terms, and the percentage of late payments caused by disputes. A dispute mechanism is added to purchase invoices to link delayed payments directly to dispute status.

item.title: RM576838: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Boost productivity with Copilot - Use Copilot Cowork to orchestrate insights and actions across Dynamics 365 ERP
item.description: The Copilot Cowork plugin for finance and operations apps enables users to move from business intent to insight to execution in a single experience. Copilot orchestrates work across ERP data, emails, documents, spreadsheets, collaboration tools, and downstream business processes.

item.title: RM576837: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Use pick-based assignment method for work items
item.description: Use the No auto assignment method for queues in Copilot Service admin center when you want routed conversations to remain unassigned after they enter a queue. Instead of being assigned automatically, conversations stay in the queue until a service representative picks them up from their Inbox or a supervisor assigns them manually.

item.title: RM576836: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Ecommerce - Sell to business customers on more Shopify plans with B2B company sync
item.description: Shopify expanded its B2B capabilities to all plans, and the Shopify Connector for Business Central is updated accordingly. Core B2B features that previously required a Shopify Plus subscription now work on Basic, Grow, and Advanced plans.

item.title: RM576835: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data: Elevate customer experiences - Use Microsoft Fabric OneLake as a data source
item.description: Easily explore and select customer data stored in OneLake for processing in Customer Insights - Data. The OneLake connector reads directly from your OneLake data, eliminating the need to copy or stage data.

item.title: RM576834: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Omnichannel commerce - Streamline mass price updates using attribute-based pricing
item.description: This feature enhancement introduces mass price update capabilities that use price attribute combinations and rule-based markups to provide an efficient way to manage large-scale pricing changes.

item.title: RM576833: Dynamics 365 Finance: Core financials - Inquire about purchase orders processed during purchase order year-end
item.description: The purchase order year-end process can update purchase order accounting dates and carry purchasing commitments into the next fiscal year. Finance users need a simple way to confirm which purchase orders were included in that process, understand how accounting dates changed, and see the resulting document status after year-end processing.

item.title: RM576832: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Country and regional - Enable electronic invoicing in France
item.description: Business Central adds support for e-invoicing and e‑reporting in France, following the DGFiP five‑corner model. Microsoft doesn't operate as a certified Partner Dematerialization Platform (PDP); instead, companies can use existing E‑Document connectors to exchange invoices and lifecycle messages through certified PDP providers. The localization app enables two compliant formats: Peppol BIS3 (XML) and Factur‑X (PDF/A‑3 with embedded XML).

item.title: RM576831: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Workforce engagement management - Analyze adherence history to optimize workforce planning
item.description: The Adherence History Report provides a complete view of customer service representatives’ historical adherence to scheduled tasks and activities. It helps supervisors analyze patterns, identify gaps, and improve workforce efficiency.

item.title: RM576830: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Omnichannel commerce - Enable credit management support for Commerce orders
item.description: This feature enhancement extends the standard credit management framework to all Commerce orders across channels, ensuring the consistent application of credit policies between Commerce and Supply Chain Management. item.description: This feature enables merchandising managers to define specific products or entire product hierarchies as non-returnable. This can be done by enabling a new property on released products either individually, or in bulk via the category view. Once configured, POS blocks the return of such items to enforce compliance and reduce unauthorized returns. item.title: RM576828: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Store Commerce - Set payment method display order and visibility in POS
item.description: The feature introduces payment profiles that can be associated with POS registers. These payment profiles provide retailers with a flexible and centralized way to manage how payment methods appear across their POS registers. item.title: RM576827: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data: Turbocharge your pipeline to drive growth - Target right audience based on signals from earlier campaigns
item.description: You can now access behavioral data captured by Customer Insights - Journeys, such as emails opened and links clicked, and use it in Customer Insights - Data. The behavioral data from Customer Insights - Journeys is now automatically available in Customer Insights - Data.

item.title: RM576826: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Boost productivity with Copilot - Enable agents to work with attachments through Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server
item.description: Document attachments provide valuable context and detail about ERP records. With this release, the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server will provide access for agents to work with the attachments by creating, deleting, or reading and reasoning over the content of the attachments in agentic flows.

item.title: RM576825: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Boost productivity with Copilot - Open records in Dynamics 365 ERP applications with deep links from copilot responses
item.description: The Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server enables copilots to respond to prompts related to data across the Dynamics 365 ERP suite of applications. Users expect visibility into how copilot responses relate to the underlying business data and system records. With this release, copilot responses generated from the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server will include deep links to the data used to generate the response, improving transparency, traceability, and trust in the AI-generated responses.

item.title: RM576824: Power Automate: Cloud flows - Share Process license capacity across workflows
item.description: With flow groups, you can share Process license capacity across up to 25 cloud flows, optimizing license allocation and reducing costs for organizations operating higher-volume workflows that don't need their own dedicated capacity.

item.title: RM576823: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Move multiple bookings at once by a set offset
item.description: Bulk move enables schedulers to shift multiple bookings forward or backward by a consistent time offset in a single action. Instead of adjusting each booking manually, users can select bookings across one or more resources and apply changes, such as moving all affected work by a day or a week. This feature is especially valuable when plans change due to factors like weather delays, customer reschedules, or operational disruptions. It is automatically enabled for users.

item.title: RM576822: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Move multiple bookings at once to new resource
item.description: Bulk reassign simplifies large-scale staffing changes by allowing schedulers to move multiple bookings to a different resource in a single step. Instead of reassigning work one booking at a time, users can multi-select bookings and quickly redirect them to another qualified resource using a new feature in the right-click menu. This feature supports common scenarios such as covering for unexpected absences, rebalancing workloads, or shifting work between teams. It is automatically enabled for use...

item.title: RM576821: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - View full screen map mode on schedule board
item.description: Full screen map mode allows dispatchers to expand the schedule board map to fill the entire workspace, removing visual constraints that limit situational awareness. With more space, users can easily analyze resource locations, view booking distribution, and evaluate geographic coverage without distractions from other panels. This capability is particularly useful for dispatchers who rely on spatial context when assigning or adjusting work, such as route planning, proximity-based scheduling, or i...

item.title: RM576820: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Cancel segments of a booking in aggregate views
item.description: Cancel booking actions in aggregate views give schedulers precise control over long-running or multiday bookings directly within their current view. Users can cancel bookings with the same time granularity as the selected view. For example, canceling a week in a weekly view, canceling a day in a daily view. To cancel a segment, open the Edit Details panel and set the desired interval's duration to 0 minutes.

item.title: RM576819: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Omnichannel customer experiences - Use data masking to protect customer data
item.description: Customer service representative data masking is a new opt-in feature for Dynamics 365 Contact Center.

item.title: RM576818: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Improve customer outcomes with Service Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is becoming a consistent way that users interact with AI across Microsoft experiences. With this update, that same chat experience is available in Dynamics 365 Customer Service, with service-aware grounding and workflows.

item.title: RM576817: Microsoft Dataverse: Finance and operations cross application integration - Monitor data management framework with Azure Monitor Application Insights
item.description: By integrating data management framework telemetry for Dynamics 365 finance and operations apps, organizations can gain deeper visibility into data management executions, such as import and export jobs. This integration streams telemetry directly into the customer's own Azure Application Insights instance.

item.title: RM576816: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Store Commerce - Configure inline actions on transaction line items in Store Commerce
item.description: Inline actions extensibility enables retailers and implementation partners to configure the set of actions displayed per line item in the modern transaction grid in Store Commerce, using Screen Layout Designer in Dynamics 365 Commerce headquarters.

item.title: RM576815: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Governance and administration - Upload, install, and manage PTEs in the admin center

item.description: For organizations using a structured and formal invoice workflow as part of their revenue collection, it's critical that invoices can be created and worked through to completion in a timely manner. When a configuration change causes an error, it's vital that these errors get resolved quickly so as not delay revenue generation. item.description: As you scale your data management operations, bulk delete must be predictable, transparent, and safe to operate across environments. In this release, Microsoft enhances bulk delete with an improved error handling experience and solution aware configuration support, delivering a more consistent, reliable, and enterprise‑ready data cleanup workflow.

item.description: When you enable the Enable investment project for Project Operations integrated with ERP setting, you activate this feature.

item.description: This feature provides an experience to change the task calendar on the Customizable task details pane. To enable this feature, from project parameters select Enable Customize Task Pane.

item.title: RM576806: Dynamics 365 Sales: Seller experiences - Copy opportunities for repeat deals
item.description: Administrators can control whether the Copy Opportunity feature is available. When enabled, sellers can duplicate an existing opportunity to quickly create a new one.

item.title: RM576805: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Import projects in MPP files into existing projects
item.description: Previously, importing an .mpp file always created a new project. The import process copied the work breakdown structure from the .mpp file into the new project. You couldn't import a .mpp file into an existing project. This limitation made it difficult to manage projects when overall planning happens in Project Operations and individual planning happened offline in Microsoft Project for desktop.

item.title: RM576804: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Implement access restrictions on the task grid
item.description: This feature adds a security system that lets administrators restrict what users can access inside the Project for the web iFrame on projects they access but don't join as team members. Project managers can use the same system to set restrictions for team members on their projects.

item.title: RM576803: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Support currency data type in custom columns
item.description: As part of our commitment to continuously improve Project Operations, we plan to expand the Enterprise Task Custom Columns capability in an upcoming release. This enhancement builds on the existing functionality that allows you to add Date, Text, Number, and Choice fields to the task grid.

item.title: RM576802: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Country and regional - Comply with Australian Payment Times Reporting bill
item.description: Every six months, Australian companies with more than AUD100 million in annual turnover must report how and when they pay small business suppliers (suppliers with annual turnover under AUD10 million).

item.title: RM576801: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Enable time phasing of quote and contract lines
item.description: With this feature, the system automatically updates the correct sales and cost prices in quotes and contracts based on the effective date. The system calculates prices using weighted average prices for both quote line details and contract line details, so pricing calculations are precise and reliable. This automation greatly reduces the manual work needed to track and update prices. It also lowers the risk of errors and discrepancies in pricing.

item.title: RM576800: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Support lookup data type in custom columns

item.title: MC1302906: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Schedule prompts in Agent Builder
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot’s Agent Builder will support scheduled workflows to run prompts automatically on hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly cadences. Available worldwide by November 2026, this feature enables users to automate routine tasks per user, with workflows editable and enabled by default.

item.title: MC1506735: Microsoft Planner: AI-generated status reports in Planner Agent
item.description: Microsoft Planner now includes AI-generated status reports via Planner Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, summarizing plan progress, risks, and next steps. Users with a Copilot license can customize and generate reports from accessible plan data. Rollout starts late October 2026, with no required user action.

item.description: Starting November 4, 2026, default users in Microsoft Entra can create agent blueprints unless administrators disable this via the "Users can create agent blueprints" setting. item.description: Classic Outlook for Windows will receive visual updates like improved icons, spacing, and alignment starting early November 2026, enhancing clarity and consistency without changing workflows. No admin action is needed; users and help desks should be informed of appearance changes. These updates do not replace the classic experience.

item.description: Starting November 4, Microsoft Entra will stop automatically granting the AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager permission to agent blueprints. Admin consent will be required for agents to create identities. This change, rolling out worldwide in November 2026, enhances control and auditability of agent identity creation.

Rollout begins late September 2026, requiring a Copilot license and admin enablement.

item.description: Microsoft is retiring the App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com by November 30, 2026, consolidating app creation into Copilot Cowork and Microsoft Copilot Studio. item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app's Audio Overviews on PDFs, which create AI-generated podcast-style summaries for commercial users, will be retired worldwide on October 30, 2026. item.description: New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will let users create inbox rules that auto-reply with saved templates, automating routine responses. item.description: The Microsoft Graph AuditLogQuery API will be generally available in October 2026, replacing the Search-UnifiedAuditLog PowerShell cmdlet, which will retire on October 15, 2027. Organizations using Search-UnifiedAuditLog must migrate to the API to avoid disruptions, as future audit search enhancements will focus on the API.

item.description: AI citations analytics will help you track the usage of SP documents, news and pages through copilot and AI agents. You will be able to see how often a page or a file is referenced in a copilot response. You can also get insights into SharePoint site content getting referenced in copilot responses aggregated at the site level.

item.description: Engage is rolling out Custom Branding, a new admin-led capability that lets organizations define a customized, tenant-wide visual identity across the Engage web and mobile apps. Engage-level admins can configure a brand name, add large and small logos, and a theme color that is applied consistently for all users in the tenant. Branding is managed from the new Brand Center in the Viva Engage admin center and helps organizations reinforce their identity throughout the Engage experience.

item.title: RM568072: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard - Targeted Audience Surveys
item.description: Targeted Audience Surveys let change leaders launch a Copilot Pulse survey directly from the Copilot Dashboard to all licensed or active users. Audiences update automatically using Insights data and respect existing dashboard filters like organization and job function, with privacy protected through population-level reporting only. Pair adoption metrics with employee sentiment in just a few clicks.
